fields.name: SCALE: State-Calibrated Latent Embeddings for JEPA Planning in the Right Geometry
fields.value: Unity Technologies — Compares two ways to obtain non-collapsed representations in JEPA world models used for planning, inheriting a pretrained feature space (DINO-WM) versus end-to-end training with anti-collapse regularisation (LeWM), and adds SCALE, a training-time regulariser that aligns latent distances with distanc

fields.name: CaliBench: Are the Stochastic Dynamics of Video World Models Physically Calibrated?
fields.value: Odyssey (flag) — CaliBench tests whether video world models reproduce the correct statistical distribution of physical outcomes, evaluating six image-to-video models on nine scenes with analytically known outcome distributions (Galton boards, dice, roulette, cards and others).

fields.name: ES3D: Embedding Semantics into 3D Space for Component-Aware Editing
fields.value: NetEase Fuxi AI Lab — ES3D embeds semantics directly into 3D space to enable component-aware retrieval and editing of a 3D asset, conditioned on one or more local reference images and an optional text query.
